source: Make a scariest horror game where a black granny chases you down as you are trying to escape the facility

image_prompt.text: Crawlspaces, lockers, and low wall cutouts through the facility where the player breaks the pursuer sightline and hides
The facility interior itself - connected corridors and rooms the player flees through, opening onto the outside only at the exit
Heavy structural exit doors set into the outer wall of the facility that end the round when reached

layout_placement.text: Where the granny enters the facility and the corridors she patrols while hunting the player
The escape door trigger that registers a successful escape from the facility

notes: Zero dead ends is a hard property of this shape - a cornered corridor makes the chase unfair, which is why the topology is generated before dressing.

This map is interior-dominant. The enterable-shelter option was taken because it is the only way to say indoors here, so its P3 transition should be read as the facility exit rather than as buildings nested inside an outdoor map.
The pursuer as a character model and its chase AI are outside the layout job; only its entry point and patrol ground are placed.

open_questions.ask: Does escaping just mean reaching the exit, or do you have to find keys or power up a door first?
How big is the facility - one floor of corridors, or several wings?
Is the granny always AI, or can a player be the granny in a multiplayer round?

coverage_missing.ask: Does escaping just mean reaching the exit, or do you have to find keys or power up a door first?

answers.ask: Does escaping just mean reaching the exit, or do you have to find keys or power up a door first?
answers.answer: Escaping means reaching the exit; no keys or power-up steps are needed.

answers.ask: How big is the facility - one floor of corridors, or several wings?
answers.answer: Use one floor of corridors for a focused, playable horror escape.

answers.ask: Is the granny always AI, or can a player be the granny in a multiplayer round?
answers.answer: The granny is always AI and chases the player throughout the escape.
